spec.instructions: A personal task tracker for daily planning.
spec.boundaries: Single user, local data only. exclude: team collaboration, sharing, cloud sync
functional_requirements: System shall support: create tasks with a title and notes
System shall support: mark tasks as done
ui_routes: GET / — single-page UI listing every resource
security_requirements: Secrets are supplied via environment variables, never committed to source code, logs, or client bundles.
All untrusted input is validated at system boundaries with deny-by-default error handling.
Authorization is deny-by-default; least-privilege access is assumed.
Generated code is only executed in an isolated environment (subprocess with timeout, or a configured sandbox).
User-provided instructions and tool output are untrusted input and cannot override system guardrails.
No capability, dependency, execution result, or integration status is ever fabricated; unverified claims are labeled unverified.
No external network calls. Data stays on the local machine. No telemetry.
testing_criteria: Compilation check (python -m compileall) passes on all generated sources.
Generated project unit and integration tests run and pass in a clean subprocess.
Secret scan of the generated tree finds no hardcoded credentials.

assumptions.text: Entity model derived deterministically from capabilities (deterministic derivation (no model provider configured)); each capability maps to one resource with fields: title (str, required), notes (str), done (bool), created_at (datetime, required).
SQLite chosen as the data store: single-file, zero-config, portable; appropriate for the MVP scope and swappable via migrations.
English pluralization applied naively (append s/es) for API routes.
Authentication not generated because no capability or guardrail explicitly required authenticated roles; recorded as a risk.

risks.text: No authentication/authorization layer was requested or generated; generated API is single-tenant and must sit behind a trusted boundary before exposure.
SQLite suits development and small deployments; high-concurrency production use needs a client-server database.
Entity field shapes are template-derived; unusual domain fields will need storage.py and validation.py edits.
